sections: Global authority lock order and retained observations

repo_truth: Bootstrap and dynamic add/revoke/update are implemented and focused tests are green. Registry mutation recovery currently blocks every pending journal rather than applying the packet's total rollback/roll-forward table. The public committed-registry observer accepts only one bootstrap journal, so approval/promotion reject valid mutation chains. Approval remediation is concurrently hardening approval journals and must expose a narrow cross-family composition hook.
allowed_scope: Edit crates/engine/src/approver_registry_mutation.rs, crates/engine/src/approver_registry_observation.rs, and focused additive registry recovery/observation tests.
Edit crates/engine/src/approver_registry.rs or lib.rs only for narrow internal wiring after GitNexus impact and parent coordination.
Consume the approval remediation's crate-private recovery/observation interface without editing charter_approval_workflow.rs.
non_goals: Do not weaken the global lock order, all-null refusals, exact marker, ES256, counter/replay, no-lockout, or immutable-record rules.
tasks: Implement the exact registry pending-journal recovery table: delete owned pre-intent/partial staging, roll forward complete staged sets and exact/equal partial finals, restore the retained prior use head when rollback requires it, finalize matching markers, and preserve unsafe/mismatched evidence fail-closed.

Compose one deterministic registry-then-approval journal discovery and predecessor graph through the current committed use head; reject forks, unreachable priors, cycles, duplicate sequence, non-adjacent replay, and family-local optimism.
Upgrade observe_committed_approver_registry to validate and expose a complete committed bootstrap-to-mutation registry chain while retaining promotion→registry locks for the guard lifetime.
Add crash-window, partial-final, marker, cross-family advanced-head/fork, mutation-chain observation, unsafe-path, replay/ABA, and exact idempotent recovery tests.
Preserve the reconstructed bootstrap source and replay its original 4-test suite plus the dynamic mutation suite.
contracts_and_gates: Recovery completes before authority observation, randomness, native I/O, or new intent.
Only matching 72-byte raw-intent-hash markers create authority.
Final content-addressed records are never deleted; cleanup removes only owned staged/journal bytes and restores an exact prior mutable use head when required.
Public observation accepts exactly one unbroken current registry chain and exposes no orphan/uncommitted state.
Shared use authority advances only through the unique predecessor-reachable cross-family journal.
stop_conditions: Stop before HIGH/CRITICAL existing-symbol edits and report blast radius.
Return blocked rather than invent an approval-side interface or overlap the active approval remediation lane.
